Markets.title: Optimystix Entertainment shares to debut today. Here's what GMP suggests ahead of listing
Markets.summary: Optimystix Entertainment shares will debut on the NSE SME platform today following a 2.05x subscription for its Rs 108.5-crore IPO. With a zero GMP, the company is expected to experience a muted market listing.

Markets.title: Sarda Energy among 4 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
Markets.summary: On August 13, four Nifty500 stocks, including Sarda Energy, surged over 4%. This movement triggered StockEdge's RSI Trending Up scan as their Relative Strength Index crossed above 50, signaling strengthening market momentum.

Markets.title: India won political freedom in 1947. Financial freedom is the next frontier
Markets.summary: Indian households are advancing toward financial freedom through capital markets, UPI, and systematic investment plans. Mutual fund assets have surpassed Rs 82 lakh crore, driven by strong domestic investment flows.

Markets.title: FIIs dumped nearly Rs 1 lakh crore worth of these 10 stocks but 8 defied the selloff
Markets.summary: Foreign investors sold nearly Rs 1 lakh crore worth of ten Indian stocks, yet eight of these companies saw their share prices rise. Strong earnings helped drive these gains, led by a 25% increase in Bajaj Finance shares during the quarter.

Markets.title: Skyways Air sets price band for Rs 582.8 crore IPO; issue to open on Aug 24
Markets.summary: Skyways Air Services will launch its ₹582.8 crore IPO on August 24 with a price band of ₹131 to ₹138 per share. The offering, which closes on August 27, consists of a ₹398.8 crore fresh issue and a ₹184 crore offer for sale.

Markets.title: Behari Lal Engineering IPO Day 3: GMP at 28%, subscription stays strong. Should you subscribe?
Markets.summary: Behari Lal Engineering's Rs 302-crore IPO reached its final bidding day with a 28% grey market premium and a 7.78 times subscription rate by Day 2. The stock allotment is expected on August 17, followed by its NSE and BSE listing on August 19.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli troops have ordered Palestinian families to leave their homes in the village of Qusra. Soldiers are currently using some of these evacuated houses as military barracks.

Geo-Political.title: US says dozens of countries helped China dodge Trump's tariffs
Geo-Political.summary: A new US report states that dozens of countries helped China route goods through lower-tariff nations. This tactic allowed China to avoid paying the higher levies imposed by the Trump administration.

Geo-Political.title: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
Geo-Political.summary: Romania's Cernavodă nuclear plant shut down because low water levels in the Danube River, caused by extreme heat, made cooling impossible. The facility, which provides 20% of the country's electricity, is expected to remain closed for at least 10 days.

Geo-Political.title: Engine parts smashed Ryanair window that man's head was sucked out of, report says
Geo-Political.summary: A broken engine fan blade on a flight from Greece to Germany smashed a Ryanair window last month. US investigators reported that the impact caused a man's head to be sucked out of the opening.

Geo-Political.title: Person fined after using foghorn to wake sleeping polar bear
Geo-Political.summary: A person in Svalbard was fined after using a foghorn to wake a sleeping polar bear. Local regulations strictly prohibit needlessly disturbing, attracting, or pursuing polar bears.

Geo-Political.title: Conditions on US aircraft carrier at sea for more than 250 days raise alarms
Geo-Political.summary: Sailors aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln have endured deployments exceeding 250 days, leading to severe food shortages and broken plumbing. These harsh conditions have resulted in plummeting morale, with some crew members reportedly contemplating suicide.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade gap widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. Meanwhile, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% to $173.78 billion compared to the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation dropped to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid fluctuating oil prices. This increase of 0.1% from the previous month matched analyst expectations and may give the Federal Reserve more flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, while elevated global oil prices continue to pose economic risks.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the twentieth consecutive year due to a strong growth outlook and forecasts a 6.4% GDP growth rate. However, the agency has cautioned that youth protests regarding employment pose potential fiscal risks.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is making traditional university models obsolete. He also notes that India's primary challenge is ensuring workforce employability rather than simply creating jobs.

Data & Insights.title: India retail inflation likely remained unchanged at 4.4% in July: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation in July is expected to have stayed flat at 4.4%. A favorable base effect and contained underlying inflation helped offset a broad-based rise in food prices.

India.title: Exclusive: For 4 Seconds, Air India Phuket-Delhi Plane Had No Flight Controls
India.summary: An Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi lost flight controls for four seconds after the autopilot disconnected. The co-pilot pushed the control stick forward following cockpit stall warnings.

India.title: Gujarat Fraudsters Pose As 'Bullion King Of India', Dupes Man Of Rs 75 Lakh
India.summary: Fraudsters in Gujarat posed as Prithviraj Kothari, managing director of RiddiSiddhi Bullions, after researching Jain community events online. They successfully duped a man of Rs 75 lakh using this false identity.

India.title: Woman Dies After Fall From Delhi Flyover, Cops Says She Was 'Mentally Unwell'
India.summary: A woman from Shakurpur died after falling from a Delhi flyover. Police stated that she was a mother of two who had been mentally unwell and left home without informing her family.

India.title: "Cleaner, Modern": Instagram Changes Its Wordmark Logo After A Decade
India.summary: Instagram has updated its wordmark logo for the first time in a decade to achieve a cleaner and more modern look. However, many users have mocked the new script on social media for resembling the word "Instagzam."

India.title: Analysis | Turban In Punjab, Lathis In Haryana: Will Ambala Hurt BJP's Sikh Outreach?
India.summary: A confrontation occurred in Ambala on August 7 at Gurdwara Panjokhra Sahib involving anti-Khalistan leader Gursimran Singh Mand. This incident has raised concerns about whether the resulting tensions will negatively impact the BJP's efforts to reach out to the Sikh community.

India.title: Delhi Didn't Exceed Average Rainfall In A Week, Weather Body Rectifies Error
India.summary: A typing error at the Safdarjung observatory temporarily made it appear that Delhi had exceeded its monthly rainfall average. The weather body later rectified this mistake.

General.summary: British sprinter Amy Hunt won the 200m event to claim her second gold medal of the European Championships. She is now aiming to win a historic four gold medals at the event in Birmingham.
